mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_refresh_token (user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{revoked}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_refresh_token SET user_id = #{userId}, token_hash = #{tokenHash}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, revoked = #{revoked}, revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at FROM auth_refresh_token WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked = false AND expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY created_at ASC
